characters.name: Smeden
characters.description: A burly blacksmith with a rugged appearance. He is tall and muscular, with soot-stained clothes and work-worn hands. His hair is unkempt, showcasing a beard sprinkled with ash. He wields a large hammer, emphasizing his strength and frustration in his workshop setting.

characters.name: Eldste sønn
characters.description: The eldest son is adventurous and hopeful, dressed in simple peasant attire. He has a sturdy build with youthful determination in his eyes. Standing in front of the grand castle, he appears humble yet willing to take on a challenge, engaging with the king courteously.

characters.name: Gammel kjerring
characters.description: An old, wizened woman with a hunched back, sitting in a rocky crevice. Her gray hair is tied in a loose bun, and she wears a long, worn-out dress. She has a kind yet mischievous glint in her eyes as she comforts the eldest son, combing his hair with care.

characters.name: Andre sønn
characters.description: The second son is energetic and eager, depicted furiously running through the forest. He is dressed in worn clothes and looks determined, with an intense focus as he chases the magical foals, his youthful exuberance visible in his expression.

characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: The youngest son, known as Askeladden, is a slender young man with a curious spirit. He has unkempt hair and a mischievous grin. His clothes are simple and a bit dusty from staying by the hearth. Despite that, he exudes a sense of determination and wonder as he sets off on his journey.

characters.name: Yngste Foler
characters.description: The youngest of the magical foals, with a mystical presence and ethereal grace. Its coat shimmers in dappled hues, and its eyes are wise and knowing. This foal carries Askeladden on its back through an enchanting landscape, representing both guidance and companionship.
